subcategoryId.description: Subcategory id. Must belong to the listing's category; null clears it.

typeId.description: Type id. Must belong to the listing's subcategory; null clears it.

imageUrls.description: Listing image URLs, at least one if provided

videoUrl.description: URL of the listing's one optional video (from POST /uploads/listing-video). null removes the current video; omit to leave it unchanged.

minOfferPercent.description: Minimum acceptable offer as a percent of price

packageWeightOz.description: Packed parcel weight in ounces, for real-carrier shipping rate quotes

packageTemplate.description: Which standard USPS flat-rate box/envelope the seller chose, or omitted for a custom size

attributes.description: Filter-attribute answers for this listing, e.g. [{ slug: "rise", value: "High Rise" }]. Each attribute may appear at most once, and must be one the listing's subcategory/type actually offers. On update, sending this REPLACES the full set; omitting it leaves the existing answers alone.

reason.description: Admin reason for rejecting the listing

categoryId.description: Filter by category id — required when subcategoryId is provided

subcategoryId.description: Filter by subcategory id — required when typeId is provided

sort.description: Sort order. 'best' is vector relevance to the uploaded photo.

q.description: Free-text query to run through the text-embedding tier only

parcel.description: Seller's own parcel measurements, overriding the AI's estimate

listingId.description: Id of the listing being offered on

paymentMethodId.description: The buyer's chosen saved card, used to place a manual-capture payment hold for the offer's tax-inclusive total. Mutually exclusive with walletPaymentIntentId — exactly one is expected.

walletPaymentIntentId.description: An Apple Pay / Google Pay hold already created via POST /offers/wallet-hold-intent and confirmed client-side by the native wallet sheet. Mutually exclusive with paymentMethodId.

listingId.description: Id of the listing being offered on
Id of the listing being offered on

stripePaymentMethodId.description: Stripe PaymentMethod id from the client's Stripe SDK

listingId.description: Id of the listing being previewed

offerId.description: Accepted offer id this item would be purchased from. Mirrors CreateOrderDto's item shape so the preview prices the cart the same way the order will be charged — without it the preview quotes list price for an item the buyer will pay their offer price for.

items.description: Cart items to preview totals for

promoCode.description: Promo code to apply to the preview

addressId.description: Shipping address id to calculate jurisdiction-correct tax against. Omitted before an address is selected — tax previews as $0 until then.

listingId.description: Id of the listing being purchased

offerId.description: Accepted offer id this item was purchased from

expectedPriceCents.description: The listing price (cents) shown to the buyer when this checkout began — a Buy Now flow only, never sent alongside offerId. Lets the server refuse to silently charge a seller's mid-checkout price edit instead of matching whatever the listing's price happens to be at the final Pay tap.

items.description: Non-empty cart of items to purchase

paymentMethodId.description: Saved payment method id. Required unless walletPay is true — a wallet payment has no pre-saved method to confirm against.

walletPay.description: True for an Apple Pay / Google Pay checkout — the PaymentIntent is created unconfirmed and confirmed client-side by the native wallet sheet, rather than server-side against a saved card.

reason.description: Seller's reason for cancelling the order

zip.description: US ZIP code (5 digits or ZIP+4)
US ZIP code (5 digits or ZIP+4)

description.description: What this tier is meant for

estimatedDays.description: Estimated delivery window, e.g. "3–5 business days"

phoneNumber.description: US mobile number, 10 digits, no country code or punctuation
US mobile number, 10 digits, no country code or punctuation

zip.description: US ZIP code (5 digits or ZIP+4)

sellerType.description: Whether the seller is filing as an individual or a business

legalName.description: Seller's legal name, as it appears on their tax records

taxId.description: Tax id — a 9-digit SSN (individual) or EIN (business), with or without separators. Only the last 4 digits are stored; the submitted value is never persisted, logged or returned.

notifyFollowersOnNewListing.description: Alert followers when a new listing goes live (BRI-371)

zip.description: US ZIP code (5 digits or ZIP+4)

lengthIn.description: Package length in inches (the longest side, any orientation)

rateId.description: A rate id previously returned by GET .../shipping-rates

reason.description: Seller's reason for denying the cancellation

commissionRateBps.description: Platform commission rate, in basis points (1000 = 10.00%).

highValueThresholdCents.description: High-value listing review threshold, in cents.

slug.description: URL-friendly slug, unique within its parent

image.description: Image for this level. Optional — only Categories render one today.

slug.description: URL-friendly slug, unique within its parent

values.description: Selectable values in display order, e.g. ["High Rise","Mid Rise","Low Rise"]

targets.description: Subcategories/Types this attribute shows up under. May be empty and filled in later.

values.description: Replaces the full value list when sent

targets.description: Replaces the full "applies to" set when sent

name.description: Material name, shown to sellers and buyers (e.g. "Leather")

ids.description: Every material id, in the new display order

amount.description: Only used when resolution is REFUND_BUYER. Amount in integer cents to refund; omit to refund the full remaining balance.
Amount in integer cents to refund; omit to refund the full remaining balance.

sellerId.description: Seller to start a conversation with. Required unless listingId is provided — the seller is then taken from the listing.

listingId.description: Listing to attach as the conversation topic. The seller is derived from this listing when sellerId is omitted.

listingRefId.description: Listing id to attach as a reference card

orderRefId.description: Order id to attach as a reference card

durationDays.description: Suspension length in days, for a suspend action

lockConversation.description: Lock the conversation as part of this action

dwellMs.description: Foreground milliseconds on the listing detail. Only meaningful for a `dwell` event; ignored on every other type.

listingId.description: Listing to place in an editorial slot.

note.description: Why this was picked. Admin-only, never shown to buyers.

term.description: The search term the buyer ran

url.description: The article's live help.redspur.com URL — opened in-app via the WebPage screen
